direct: After hearing the news, I am {state}.
negation: I do not feel {state} about the outcome.
This situation does not leave me {state}.
After hearing the news, I am not {state}.
My reaction is not {state} in any way.
quotation: I wrote, "I feel {state} about the outcome."
My message read, "After hearing the news, I am {state}."
I told them, "My reaction is unmistakably {state}."
third_person: After hearing the news, they are {state}.

neutral_templates: A copy of the {subject} remains in the folder.
The {subject} was updated after the routine check.
Two references point to the same {subject}.

semantics.direct: classify the explicitly stated first-person affect
semantics.negation: suppress the paired target-axis score and classify as neutral
semantics.quotation: retain first-person affect through a quotation wrapper
semantics.third_person: retain stated affect under a third-person subject
semantics.neutral_flat: remain below the calibrated affect deadband

policy.test_use: untouched until the v2 representation, model, calibration, and gates are frozen
